title: fastapi-code-generator emits executable Python from untrusted OpenAPI fields
summary: Unescaped route paths and status-code keys of additional responses execute injected expressions when generated code is imported. An unescaped operation summary executes injected code when the generated handler is called.

severity.rationale: Code execution requires generation from an attacker-influenced specification and execution of the output. These prerequisites occur in developer and CI workflows, warranting 72 hours.

exposure: Workflows generating and running FastAPI applications from untrusted OpenAPI specifications are exposed.

remediation.details: Upgrade to 0.8.1 or later. As a remediation recommendation, regenerate affected output from reviewed specifications before importing or serving it.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updating or containment can interrupt dependent workflows.

verification: Confirm the installed and running component meets the documented fix or containment condition.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted for independent review.
Specified that the additional response injection sink is the status-code key, not the content-type key.
